page_title: TOR 0-2 LAZ | Torino v Lazio 22/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
90+6' One of the Lazio players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Torino are awarded the free kick.
90+5' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
88' A cross from a corner kick by Torino is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
86' Samuele Ricci (Torino) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
85' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Adam Masina and he is replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
85' What a great touch by Samuele Ricci (Torino) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the centre of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Casale (Lazio) replaces Luis Alberto.
80' A poor mid-range free-kick by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
79' Mario Gila (Lazio) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
77' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
75' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) replaces Karol Linetty.
75' Today's match ends for Koffi Djidji who will be replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gustav Isaksen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
72' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Matteo Lovato (Torino) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' 17:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' Mario Gila (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
60' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
59' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).
56' 0 - 2 A piece of footballing magic! Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) collected a precise pass and fired a shot towards the bottom right corner, bouncing in off the post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
55' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Taty Castellanos (Lazio) replacing Ciro Immobile.
55' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ivan Ilic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Ricci (Torino).
55' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.

50' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Luis Alberto, then produced a nice strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
50' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.

49' Duvan Zapata (Torino) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
48' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Maurizio Sarri probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Elseid Hysaj. He is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
46' The whistle blows and Federico La Penna starts the second half.
45' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

43' Adam Masina (Torino) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
43' Ivan Ilic (Torino) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
42' The Torino players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
39' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
39' It's going to be a corner kick.

37' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.

34' A cross from Raoul Bellanova gives Duvan Zapata (Torino) a great chance right in the middle of the box, but he chooses the wrong option and sends a header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
33' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat. Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Luis Alberto (Lazio) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

29' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Lazio will take a corner kick.
27' That's a clear yellow card. Karol Linetty (Torino) goes into the book.
22' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
21' Duvan Zapata (Torino) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
20' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
18' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel was alert and made a comfortable save.
17' A pass from Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is intercepted by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic and the move breaks down.
15' Ivan Ilic (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
14' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) will take a corner kick.

10' Duvan Zapata (Torino) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
9' Referee Federico La Penna sees the trip by Karol Linetty (Torino) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lazio.
6' Torino fail to score from a corner as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post!
2' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and signals a foul after Duvan Zapata (Torino) brought his opponent down.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico La Penna.
